text: When cast, this spell enfeebles enemy minds; they feel the crushing weight of reality bearing down upon them.
The caster weaves a confounding fog that numbs and deludes enemies, causing them to stumble and stagger.
The spellcaster opens a vortex leading into the Pit. Anything caught within it will be lost forever.
The Wizard destroys their enemies from within, corroding foes' minds with doubt and crisis.
Master of Blade, Bow and Magic
If it can be casted, shot or slashed with, this one has mastered all he decided to learn.
What is a ranger without an arrow? Who can be the best without dozens?
A ranger should give no reprieve to the foe. Arrows must fall like a deluge, as deadly as lightning.
Let each bolt be imbued with the strength of Kurnous, and bring death to all his enemies.
When the arrow flies farther, it may kill sooner, which is vital in the Hunt.
This mage has witnessed and caused death so often, he is tied to the wind of it.
This mage is a master at shadowplay.
This mage has mastered necromancy completely.
